name: Legal Aid with Legal Fees
title:
4.5K views · 18 reactions | What happens when you can't afford a lawyer?

When Alexis' mother left her ex-husband, she had no job and no roof over her head. All she wanted was a divorce. But as the legal fees piled up, the lawyer she had hired told her to apply for legal aid.

To get legal aid, applicants must pass a means test and a merits test. Their cases are then handled by the Legal Aid Bureau's in-house lawyers or by private solicitors who take them on pro bono or at a reduced rate.

While her ex-husband was represented by a lawyer from a large firm, Alexis' mother was referred to a lawyer who was patient and experienced. She got her divorce.

Today, her daughter, Alexis, is studying law, hoping to become the kind of lawyer her mother had.
